style_guide.art_style: Polished Korean romance webtoon style with expressive romantic comedy acting, attractive characters, soft cinematic framing, clean modern manhwa aesthetics
style_guide.render_style: Finished vertical webtoon panel, clean digital painting, soft shading, subtle texture, high detail faces, readable expressions
style_guide.line_style: Clean line art, elegant thin-to-medium outlines, expressive facial lines, subtle comedic exaggeration when needed
style_guide.color_palette: COVID-era urban cafe palette, soft beige, muted pink, clean white, gentle blue-gray shadows, warm skin tones
style_guide.lighting_style: Soft natural daylight for clinic and cafe, cozy indoor lighting for rooms, subtle dramatic shadow for Seowoo tension scenes
style_guide.global_negative_prompt: low quality, blurry, extra fingers, distorted face, inconsistent character design, unreadable text, messy speech bubbles, western comic style, overly realistic photo, horror, gore

episode.title: 밀접접촉자입니다 - 3: 사람 마음도 2m 지키면 안전해요?
episode.style: cafe reunion, triangular tension, Seowoo's jealousy cliffhanger

character_bible.name: 윤아진
character_bible.role: female lead, COVID-rule obsessed student preparing to study abroad
character_bible.visual_core: fresh rabbit-like beauty, bright clear eyes, soft cheeks, neat black or dark brown hair, youthful and intelligent aura, expressive blush
character_bible.wardrobe: neat casual campus clothes, KF94 mask, small crossbody bag, always carrying sanitizer, wipes, spare masks, study-abroad document folder
character_bible.expression_notes: easily flustered, anxious when COVID or study abroad is mentioned, tries to look rational, blushes when Jihwak flirts
character_bible.personality_notes: smart, rule-abiding, sincere, overthinks romance as symptoms, clumsy only with emotions

character_bible.name: 강지확
character_bible.role: male lead, instinctively charming and direct
character_bible.visual_core: Arabian puppy-like handsome face, thick eyebrows, deep eyes, sharp facial structure, slightly exotic first impression, warm playful eyes when smiling
character_bible.wardrobe: clean casual clothes, hoodie or knit, black or white mask, simple bag, relaxed but stylish campus look
character_bible.expression_notes: playful eyes, relaxed smile, becomes quietly sincere when A-jin is anxious, flirts naturally without overacting
character_bible.personality_notes: unaware star quality, capable, warm, direct once he cares, jokes to ease tension

character_bible.name: 백서우
character_bible.role: second male lead, soft controlling antagonist
character_bible.visual_core: tofu-fox type, pale clean face, gentle eyes, neat hair, elegant and controlled expression, beautiful but cold under the surface
character_bible.wardrobe: neat shirt or cardigan, perfectly worn mask, clean campus style, carries carefully prepared care kits
character_bible.expression_notes: soft smile with cold eyes, tiny cracks when jealous, calm voice, suppressed possessiveness
character_bible.personality_notes: perfectly helpful on the outside, controlling kindness, jealous of Jihwak, wants to be chosen by A-jin

character_bible.name: 민서
character_bible.visual_core: lively Korean college girl, playful eyes, casual ponytail or bob, friendly expressive face
character_bible.wardrobe: casual cafe staff outfit or comfy room-call look, mask when outside
character_bible.expression_notes: teasing smile, exaggerated reactions, laughs easily
character_bible.personality_notes: quick-witted, sees romantic signs before A-jin does, comic relief

scenes.scene_summary: 음성 결과 후 아진은 카페에 놓고 온 유학 서류를 찾으러 가고, 지확과 다시 만난다.
scenes.visual_continuity: Same cafe as episode 1, quieter, distancing stickers on floor, study abroad folder, warm daylight through glass.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin enters the quiet cafe after negative result, wearing mask, carrying bag, looking for her study abroad folder
cuts.composition: Cafe entrance signs and sanitizer visible, A-jin small in frame
narration: 검사 결과가 음성으로 나온 뒤, 아진은 카페에 놓고 온 유학 서류를 찾으러 갔다.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin quietly collecting her study abroad documents from a table, checking if all pages are there
cuts.composition: Folder open, her careful hands emphasized

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak appears behind her and calls her name, playful eyes over mask; A-jin startled
cuts.composition: Jihwak behind, A-jin turning sharply

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak claims he came back for his 'infection prevention score', A-jin looks unimpressed but amused
cuts.composition: Distance between them maintained, empty cafe seats

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin raises her palm to stop Jihwak as he steps closer, floor distancing sticker between them
cuts.composition: Distancing sticker centered like a barrier

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak looking down at the distancing sticker, then up at A-jin with a teasing but sincere gaze
cuts.composition: Sticker foreground, Jihwak and A-jin separated above it

cuts.visual_prompt: Romantic close two-shot over the distancing sticker as Jihwak asks if hearts can stay safe at 2 meters
cuts.composition: Their eyes meet across empty space, sticker in center bottom

scenes.scene_summary: 서우가 카페에 들어오고, 아진과 지확 사이의 공기를 눈치챈다.
scenes.visual_continuity: Cafe doorway bell, triangular tension between A-jin, Jihwak, Seowoo; Seowoo's smile is soft but eyes don't smile.

cuts.visual_prompt: Cafe door opens with bell, Seowoo enters wearing perfectly fitted mask and neat clothes; A-jin and Jihwak turn at the same time
cuts.composition: Seowoo at door, A-jin and Jihwak separated inside, triangle composition

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo's eyes move first to Jihwak before A-jin, soft smile with cold gaze
cuts.composition: His eyes emphasized above mask

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin waves hands flustered while Jihwak answers calmly, Seowoo observing both reactions
cuts.composition: A-jin center flustered, Jihwak calm side, Seowoo at doorway

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo approaches A-jin and naturally checks her study abroad folder, acting helpful
cuts.composition: Seowoo beside A-jin, folder between them

dialogue.speaker: 백서우
dialogue.text: 유학 서류 찾으러 온 거야? 내가 봐줄게.

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo intentionally speaks while looking at Jihwak, A-jin unaware of the subtext
cuts.composition: Seowoo foreground, Jihwak in background, A-jin between them

dialogue.speaker: 백서우
dialogue.text: 아진이는 중요한 일 앞두고 있어서, 괜히 흔들리면 안 되거든.

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak responds softly but firmly, A-jin looks at him again, Seowoo's expression tightens
cuts.composition: Jihwak's calm face, A-jin's stirred expression, Seowoo in partial shadow

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin touched by Jihwak's words, eyes softening over mask while holding her documents
cuts.composition: A-jin isolated, background slightly blurred

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo watches A-jin look at Jihwak, his polite smile fading for the first time
cuts.composition: Half of his face in soft cafe shadow

scenes.scene_summary: 카페를 나온 서우는 위험 동선 정보를 듣고도 아진과 지확을 바라보며 흔들린다.
scenes.visual_continuity: Street outside cafe, glass window showing A-jin and Jihwak inside, Seowoo alone outside, phone call with Minjae.

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo walking alone outside the cafe, phone ringing, late afternoon shadows, his expression controlled
cuts.composition: Cafe window behind him, phone vibrating in hand
narration: 카페를 나온 뒤, 서우는 혼자 걸으며 누군가에게 전화를 받았다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of phone caller ID '민재', Seowoo glances around before answering
cuts.composition: Caller ID prominent, Seowoo's hand tense

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo on phone, face stiffening as he hears about a possible infected route near a gathering he attended
cuts.composition: His eyes narrow, background slightly darkened

dialogue.speaker: 민재
dialogue.text: 너 그날 확진자 나온 모임 근처에 있었다며. 혹시 연락 온 거 없어?

cuts.visual_prompt: Minjae's voice continues through the phone, Seowoo's gaze shifting toward cafe window
cuts.composition: Phone to ear, cafe glass reflection across his face

dialogue.speaker: 민재
dialogue.text: 그래도 조심해. 너 그날 아진이 만났다며? 혹시 모르니까 말은 해.

cuts.visual_prompt: Through cafe glass, A-jin and Jihwak are visible inside smiling at each other; Seowoo outside watches from shadow
cuts.composition: Seowoo foreground dark, A-jin and Jihwak warm inside

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo grips phone tightly, knuckles tense, his soft expression gone
cuts.composition: Hand gripping phone, slight crack of pressure lines

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of Seowoo's face, gentle smile erased, only cold eyes remain, dramatic shadow
cuts.composition: Face centered, one eye in shadow

cuts.visual_prompt: Black fade panel with next episode preview text, ominous but clean webtoon ending
cuts.composition: Black background, centered text space
